name: Massachusetts Institute of Technology
summary: MIT in Cambridge, Massachusetts: 56 undergraduate majors in five schools, entered undeclared; about 65% of undergraduates join research each year.

ib.text: No IB points minimum is published. Your school sends predicted IB grades if available; only admitted students send final results. SAT or ACT is required.

dates.label: Early Action (non-binding, open to international applicants) closes

programmes.name: Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
programmes.about: Course 6 runs a family of degrees from electrical science to computer science, AI and decision-making, computation and cognition, and computer science with economics and data science, with a hands-on approach.
programmes.selectionNote: You apply to MIT, not to a major; everyone starts undeclared and can then choose any course with no further admission step.

flagshipSource.title: MIT EECS: the largest undergraduate program at MIT

notes: MIT says it is need-blind and meets 100% of demonstrated need for all undergraduates, domestic and international.
2026-27 tuition is $66,720 and the full cost of attendance is $92,760, before any financial aid.
Early Action is not single-choice or binding: you can apply anywhere else, and the financial aid form is due 30 November for Early Action applicants.
